description: This file defines the 'Lcm' class, which provides a method to calculate the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of multiple numbers, including auxiliary private methods for factorization and processing factors.

classes.name: Lcm
classes.description: Provides static methods to compute the least common multiple (LCM) of multiple numbers, including internal helper methods for factorization and validation.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the least common multiple (LCM) of the provided arguments, handling nulls, non-negatives, and multiple inputs.

methods.name: factors
methods.description: Private method to compute an array of prime factors for a given number.

methods.name: processPoweredFactors
methods.description: Private method to process and combine the prime factors with their highest powers for LCM calculation.

methods.name: testNonNulls
methods.description: Private method to ensure that at least one input value is non-null; throws an exception otherwise.
